name: animated-history-studio
description: 2D cartoon characters in a 3D Pompeii scene rendered by Remotion and GitHub Actions

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PompeiiShort out/pompeii.mp4 --codec h264 --gl swangle --concurrency 1 --crf 19
scripts.still: remotion still src/index.ts PompeiiShort out/preview.png --frame 240 --gl swangle
scripts.render:bridge:preview: remotion render src/index.ts BridgeTemplate out/bridge_sample.mp4 --frames 0-119 --scale 0.5 --codec h264 --gl swangle --concurrency 1 --crf 20 --props='{"post":{"dpr":0.5}}'
scripts.still:bridge: remotion still src/index.ts BridgeTemplate out/bridge_preview.png --frame 120 --scale 0.5 --gl swangle --props='{"post":{"dpr":0.5}}'
scripts.render:pompeii:adapted: remotion render src/index.ts PompeiiAdapted out/pompeii_adapted.mp4 --codec h264 --gl swangle --scale 0.5 --concurrency 1 --crf 20
